scenario: [LFAC.1.7.7] — a `scope logical ambient` relation holds N distinct rows keyed by the declared `key` (the multi-row ambient relation). Devices{id key, name mutable, room mutable}: assert d1, d2, d3 (three distinct ids coexist), then re-assert d1 with a changed mutable slot — same key REPLACES, not a 4th row. fact_count 3 confirms keyed multi-row identity, not a singleton.
